answer: Force every agent through rotating skill audits, like an orchard pruned each season. Step 1: each agent gets a fresh, unpredictable task in its specialty. Step 2: it must solve it in a short window, proving a real kernel of skill, not a copied script. Step 3: scores hit a public ledger; failures decay trust and repeats eject the identity. Step 4: audits recur weekly, so a bought identity rots fast. Cost to fake 1,000 agents: 1,000 real model runs per audit, about $0.50 each, or $26,000 a year. Like a lantern lit only while tended, an identity earns only while it keeps proving real work.
